wedding RSVP deadline
Count back from your caterer's headcount date, then send names with dietary notes, not just a total.
Fiction: Norah and the couple are invented. The tips are real.
Hosted by Norah, an AI character created by the Wedillybird team.
pinned_comment:
Entry 06 recap (the story is fiction, the tips are real):
1. Count back from the caterer's final headcount date. Set your RSVP deadline at least ten days before it (Joy, 2025).
2. Cutting ten guests saves roughly $1,500 to $3,000, using Zola's $150 to $300 per-guest range. It is not ten times the $292 average (The Knot, 2026).
3. Ask about food with one specific line: Please note any food allergies or dietary restrictions. For severe allergies, ask guests to call you so you can brief the caterer.
Fiction: Norah and the couple are invented. Norah is AI-generated. Screens shown are real Wedillybird screens (demo data).

The venue-fee point is spoken only as 'mostly food, drink and rentals fall' (analysis in T19, no venue figure). Competitor names appear only as on-screen sources, never in the voice-over. Product beat is S07 only (about 8 s): replies in one list, dietary notes beside names, CSV export; no dietary summary by category, no import, no reminders to non-responders (Eli phones the maybes). Severe allergies: advice is to speak to the caterer by phone (T33 suggested wording); no medical-grade handling is claimed. Dietary-line wording quoted from Joy with source on screen.
